map.为何铺铜能降 PCB 温升？: Why does copper pour lower PCB temperature rise?
map.铜导热率 400W/m·K，铺铜扩大散热面积并均温；同时降地线阻抗与 EMI。本: Copper has a thermal conductivity of 400 W/m·K, and a copper pour enlarges the heat dissipation area while spreading heat evenly; it also lowers ground impedance and EMI.
